hypothesis: One-shot candidate/workspace APIs may retain caller-owned mutable operation and inventory dictionaries after validation, permitting a stale or unvalidated isolated candidate under controlled trusted-process configuration drift.
reproductions: Mutate original replacement text after successful validate_operation, before rewrite copies it.
Mutate action from the validated MODIFY to REMOVE after validation; inspect whether a non-retired owned claim is removed from the isolated candidate.
Mutate physical synthetic current source plus caller source_files digest during rewrite after source facts have been snapshotted; inspect whether final recheck accepts a changed inventory.
source_scope: Owned synthetic temporary fixtures only; no real documents or external repositories changed.
proposed_control: Freeze operation/specification containers per call before validation; preserve current source rechecks against the pinned copy. A later explicit newly valid configuration remains supported.
additional_boundary_control: prepare must be a strict Boolean, to avoid a truthy string causing candidate filesystem writes.
additional_mutable_entrypoints: Direct lifecycle packet doc change during source observation may cause false NO-OP.
FAQ packet doc change after decision may cause false NO-OP.
FAQ document bytes replaced in caller dictionary after initial checksum can overwrite an unvalidated changed owned claim in the candidate.
scope_note: The initial three application/workspace failures are already corrected; this extension checks the same validated-then-reread pattern at remaining direct planner/FAQ APIs before claiming coherent per-call snapshots.
